title: 第157章 灵剑真人的难处和请求第156章 灵剑真人的请求和尴尬
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “放心吧，我这点信誉还是有的。”
“天剑门这些年招收的弟子并不多，符合条件的弟子很少，而且，陨落的弟子数量逐步增加，灵州那边的威胁不断提升，还有就是我天剑门的一些弟子比较喜欢冒险，喜欢挑战极限，所以。”
灵剑真人自己都不好意思说了，宗门弟子的性格比较极端，比较喜欢作死，不少弟子都想要极限锤炼自己的剑气，锤炼自己的身体，不少弟子用各种极限办法修炼，有的甚至于用雷电锤炼身体，实力强大的弟子还好说，寻常弟子也这么做，那不是去送死吗？
加上天剑门的一些功法比较特殊，比较……要命，这才造就了天剑门现在的局面，想要培养一个弟子可不容易，找到一个合适的弟子更加不容易，这些年来，天剑门都在招收弟子，无奈，拥有天赋的人实在太少了。
天剑门所需要的弟子比较特殊，需要有剑道天赋，加上麾下地盘里的人类数量有限，比不上天都门和积尘宗，基数不够大，所以，弟子的数量自然不够多。
还有一点就是，天都门和积尘宗所需要的弟子比较多，没那么苛刻，各种各样的弟子都要，比如有修炼天赋的，有炼丹天赋的，有种植天赋的，有阵法天赋的等等，只要是有天赋的弟子，都需要。
各色各样的弟子都需要，而且，所需要的天赋没那么高，主打一个依靠弟子数量来完成宗门的积累，有些弟子前期没天赋，不呈现出来，后期慢慢呈现，这样的弟子不在少数。
依靠天赋和根骨来判断，终究是忽略了一批人，天剑门走的是精英路线，这就导致了他们选择弟子的数量有限，每年招收的弟子也就几十个到几百个，其中，大部分都会死去。
“哎，天剑门的情况就是如此，我也很难受，宗门的那些长辈们很少去管这方面的事情，交给我去管，我虽说不是天剑门的门主，所做的事情和门主没什么区别。”
“要不然，我也不会如此着急，实在是我做不到他们那样，可以不管那么多，专心修炼。”
灵剑真人十分无奈，他主管天剑门的大部分事情，所拥有的权力和门主没什么区别，基本上宗门的大小事情都掌管，就差……一个门主头衔，实际上，没什么区别。
他需要帮手，需要心然长老帮忙，这方面，心然长老是有天赋的，而且，心然长老回归宗门之后，他可以轻松不少，可以有时间修炼，不需要什么事情都操心。
宗门的其他人，当真是没有这个天赋，也没有这个能力，大部分的弟子天赋不错，剑道天赋很好，问题是这样的人，大部分都会有一些特殊，比如比较孤僻，比如比较执着于修炼，比如比较专一。
处理这些事情，他们不在行，反而会很容易得罪人，这就苦了灵剑真人，他没办法，门主直接把这些事情放在他的身上，自己去闭关修炼。
“哎，我也很难的，偌大一个门派，我什么事情都要管，你说我容易吗？”
“心然师妹是个非常好的人才，她回去天剑门之后，可以帮助我掌管这些事情，也可以帮我分担一些压力，让我可以轻松一些，不然，我为何执着于心然师妹。”
“有天赋的弟子多的是，我需要的不是那种执拗的人，而是可以处理各种事情的人。”
“现在心然师妹无法跟我回去，她要留在此地照顾孩子，我没办法，只能去找明剑子和明悟子他们，我相信他们还是很想去天外的，其他的门派不可能招收他们，就算是招收了，也不可能培养他们。”
“唯有我天剑门会全力培养他们，毕竟，他们本就是属于我天剑门的弟子。”
灵剑真人敞开了心扉，说出了自己的一些难处，等同于告诉陈初阳，他没有其他的意思，需要一个帮手而已。
明剑子和明悟子都很好，明悟子剑道天赋强大，明剑子呢，各方面都非常不错，是心然长老的替代，还有其他的灵剑门的人，都非常不错，可以带他们去天剑门，特别是那些灵剑门的长老，别看他们年龄大了，等他们到了天剑门，稍微培养一下，帮助他们突破修为，寿命会迅速增加。
那个世界的人，能够修炼有成的人，都不简单，天赋是没有问题的，并且，他们经过了生死和时间考验，心性问题那是真的强大，比起寻常弟子更加强大，更加值得培养。
起码，他们不会和新招收的那些弟子一样，喜欢作死。
“你看着办吧，这些事情无需和我说，你留着对他们说，我还是那句话，只要你能说服他们，他们愿意跟你离去，我不会阻止，若是你无法说服他们，我可不会帮忙的。”陈初阳摆摆手，不想插手他的事情，那些人怎么想，要不要跟着他离去，要看他们的选择。
还要看灵剑真人的诚意，估计很难说服他们，灵剑真人也很清楚，他需要陈初阳帮忙。
“陈初阳，我需要你一句话，你不开口，他们不可能同意的。”灵剑真人直视陈初阳，希望得到他的允许。
他不允许的话，灵剑门的弟子不可能点头，也不可能跟着他离去。
没有陈初阳背书，那些弟子可不会轻易离去，他们害怕被杀，毕竟凡是去了天外的人，大部分都死了。
灵剑门有不少人去了天外，下场就是死亡，所以，那个世界大部分人都对天外有着警惕之心，不会轻易离去，也不会轻易跟着他离去。
天外，代表着死亡，代表着危险，没有实力之前，不能够轻易前去。
“可以，我可以帮你说一句话，只是一句话，多了可就没有，剩下的你自己想办法解决。”陈初阳终究是心软了，不对，应该说是看到了灵剑真人的诚意，他可以判断出来，此人，没有说谎，而是真心实意的。
想要在他面前说谎，可是很难做的，灵剑真人估计是真的想要带一批弟子去天剑门培养，增强天剑门的底蕴和实力。

content_en:
"Don't worry, I still have some credibility."
"Tianjian Sect has not recruited many disciples in recent years, and there are very few disciples who meet the requirements. Moreover, the number of fallen disciples is gradually increasing, and the threat from Lingzhou is constantly increasing. In addition, some of my disciples from Tianjian Sect are more adventurous and like to challenge their limits, so."
Master Lingjian himself was embarrassed to say it. The disciples of the sect had a rather extreme personality and preferred to seek death. Many disciples wanted to temper their sword energy and their bodies to the extreme. Many disciples used various extreme methods to practice, and some even used thunder and lightning to temper their bodies. It was okay for the powerful disciples, but ordinary disciples also did the same. Wouldn't that mean they were going to die?
In addition, some of the skills of Tianjian Sect are special and... deadly. This has created the current situation of Tianjian Sect. It is not easy to train a disciple, and it is even more difficult to find a suitable disciple. Over the years, Tianjian Sect has been recruiting disciples, but unfortunately, there are too few people with talents.
The disciples Tianjian Sect needs are quite special, they need to be talented in swordsmanship. In addition, the number of humans in the territory under its command is limited and cannot compare with Tiandu Sect and Jichen Sect. The base number is not large enough, so the number of disciples is naturally not enough.
Another point is that Tiandu Sect and Jichen Sect require more disciples and are not so demanding. All kinds of disciples are needed, such as those with cultivation talents, those with alchemy talents, those with planting talents, those with formation talents, etc. As long as they are talented disciples, they are all needed.
All kinds of disciples are needed, and the required talents are not that high. The main one relies on the number of disciples to complete the accumulation of the sect. Some disciples have no talent in the early stage and do not show it, but slowly show it in the later stage. There are not a few such disciples.
Judging by relying on talent and basic skills, after all, a group of people are ignored. Tianjian Sect takes the elite route, which results in a limited number of disciples they choose. They only recruit dozens to hundreds of disciples every year, and most of them will die.
"Hey, the situation of Tianjian Sect is like this, and I feel very uncomfortable. The elders of the sect rarely take care of this matter, leaving it to me. Although I am not the sect leader of Tianjian Sect, what I do is no different from the sect leader."
"Otherwise, I wouldn't be so anxious. I really can't do what they do. I can just ignore so many things and concentrate on practicing."
Master Lingjian was very helpless. He was in charge of most affairs of the Tianjian Sect, and his power was no different from that of the sect leader. Basically, he was in charge of all matters of the sect, except for... the title of sect leader. In fact, there was no difference.
He needs help, he needs help from Elder Xinran. In this regard, Elder Xinran is talented. Moreover, after Elder Xinran returns to the sect, he can relax a lot and have time to practice without having to worry about everything.
Others in the sect really do not have this talent, nor do they have this ability. Most of the disciples have good talents and are very talented in swordsmanship. The problem is that most of these people have some special characteristics, such as being more lonely, being more persistent in cultivation, and being more single-minded.
If they are not good at dealing with these things, they will easily offend others. This is a pain for Master Lingjian. He has no choice but to put these things on him and go into seclusion to practice.
"Hey, it's difficult for me too. In such a large sect, I have to take care of everything. Do you think it's easy for me?"
"Junior Sister Xinran is a very good talent. After she returns to Tianjian Sect, she can help me take charge of these things. She can also help me share some of the pressure so that I can relax. Otherwise, why would I be obsessed with Junior Sister Xinran."
"There are many talented disciples. What I need is not the kind of stubborn person, but someone who can handle all kinds of things."
"Now Junior Sister Xinran can't go back with me. She has to stay here to take care of her children. I have no choice but to go to Ming Jianzi and Ming Wuzi. I believe they still want to go to Tianwai. It's impossible for other sects to recruit them. Even if they recruit them, it's impossible to train them."
"Only our Tianjian Sect will do our best to train them. After all, they are my disciples."
Master Lingjian opened his heart and told some of his difficulties, which was equivalent to telling Chen Chuyang that he had no other intentions and just needed a helper.
Ming Jianzi and Ming Wuzi are both very good. Ming Wuzi is very talented in swordsmanship. Ming Jianzi is very good in all aspects. He is the replacement of Elder Xinran. There are other people from the Spirit Sword Sect who are all very good. You can take them to the Tianjian Sect, especially the elders of the Spirit Sword Sect. Regardless of their age, when they arrive at the Tianjian Sect, you can train them a little and help them break through the cultivation level, and their life span will increase rapidly.
People in that world, those who can achieve success in cultivation, are not simple. There is no problem with their talent. Moreover, they have passed the test of life and death and time. They are really powerful when it comes to xinxing issues. They are stronger than ordinary disciples and more worthy of training.
At least, they won't like to seek death like the newly recruited disciples.
"You can do it. You don't need to tell me these things. You can keep it to them. I still say the same thing. As long as you can convince them and they are willing to leave with you, I will not stop you. If you can't convince them, I will not help." Chen Chuyang waved his hands, not wanting to interfere with his affairs. What do those people think? It depends on their choice whether to follow him or not.
It also depends on the sincerity of Master Lingjian. It is probably difficult to convince them. Master Lingjian also knows very well that he needs Chen Chuyang's help.
"Chen Chuyang, I need a word from you. If you don't speak, they won't agree." Master Lingjian looked directly at Chen Chuyang, hoping to get his permission.
If he didn't allow it, the disciples of the Spirit Sword Sect would not be able to nod or follow him and leave.
Without Chen Chuyang's endorsement, those disciples would not leave easily. They were afraid of being killed. After all, most of those who went to Tianwai died.
Many people from the Spirit Sword Sect went to Tianwai and their fate was death. Therefore, most people in that world were wary of Tianwai and would not leave easily or follow him.
Tianwai represents death and danger. You cannot go there easily before you have the strength.
"Yes, I can help you with one sentence, just one sentence, nothing more. You can figure out the rest by yourself." Chen Chuyang finally relented. No, it should be said that he saw the sincerity of Master Lingjian. He could tell that this person did not lie, but was sincere.
It is difficult to lie in front of him. Master Lingjian probably really wants to bring a group of disciples to Tianjian Sect to train them and enhance the foundation and strength of Tianjian Sect.
